# Account button: `jl-account-button`

The person signed in, in the frame of an app: avatar, name and role, opening their account.

- Class `JlAccountButton`, a molecule: `import { JlAccountButton } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/account-button

The account button shows the person signed in, where an app's frame keeps them: at the foot of the
side nav on a computer, in the top bar on a phone. Their avatar, their name, and a line under it, usually their role.

With an href it is a link to their account page; without one it is a button that fires press, to open a menu
(My account, Sign out). compact keeps the avatar alone, the name as its tooltip. See the Navigation pattern.

## Use

```ts
import { JlAccountButton } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlAccountButton
  description="Administrator"
  href="#"
  name="Marie Rochat"
/>
```

```html
<jl-account-button
  description="Administrator"
  href="#"
  name="Marie Rochat"
></jl-account-button>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. Their name; their initials make the avatar without a picture.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. The line under the name: their role, their company.
- `src` (attribute `src`): `string`, default `''`. Their picture.
- `href` (attribute `href`): `string`, default `''`. Their account page: the button becomes a link.
- `compact` (attribute `compact`): `boolean`, default `false`. The avatar alone.
- `current` (attribute `current`): `boolean`, default `false`. Their account page is the one shown: marked as the side nav marks its current place.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `press` (`onPress` in JSX), detail `undefined`: It was pressed, or its link followed.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the button.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The button, or the link.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### In a side nav

At the foot of a side nav, a link to My account.

```html
<div style="width: 240px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg)">
  <jl-account-button name="Marie Rochat" description="Administrator" href="#"></jl-account-button>
</div>
```

### Compact

compact, in the top bar of a phone.

```html
<div class="row" style="justify-content: space-between; width: 320px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--jl-line); border-radius: var(--jl-radius-lg)">
  <strong>swstock</strong>
  <span class="row" style="gap: 4px">
    <jl-search-button compact></jl-search-button>
    <jl-account-button name="Sara Monnier" description="Employee" compact href="#"></jl-account-button>
  </span>
</div>
```
